about: Oggetti (Blocco 10c), generate con npm run kimodo -- --series scripts/kimodo-series-objects.json --out modelli-3d/animations --keep-raw. pickup: raccoglie da terra un oggetto da lanciare (la mano destra, dove il companion lo tiene); hug: tiene in braccio un peluche o un cuscino, in ciclo; volley: il palleggio a pallavolo (Blocco 10d), le mani sopra la testa. Scelte fra due semi ciascuna, guardate con npm run preview su Feniel.

clips.prompt: A person crouches down, reaches to the floor with the right hand, grabs something and stands back up.
A person stands facing forward with both forearms crossed in front of the chest, cuddling something soft, rocking slowly.
A person stands, quickly raises both hands above the head and pushes upward, like setting a volleyball, then lowers the arms.
